sections.name: The Unlit Boat
sections.about: The tavern in #14 on the main row facing the west-gate approach (door A, SW facade: the south wall). Taproom with the bar and the hearth, the kitchen behind a soot-brick wall, a stair hall with the stairs up to the guest rooms. Named for the boat with no lantern on the night of the first landing.

npcs.name: Hob Tennant
npcs.greeting: Sit anywhere the chair is dry. Bread and meat at Bettany's prices, because she would know if they were not.

npcs.name: Kiri-Sal
npcs.greeting: Out of my kitchen unless you can gut an eel. You cannot? Then stand by the door and I will tell you what you are missing.

interactives.text: Over the hearth: a painted boat with no lantern, nosing in toward a hill where every hand holds up what light it had. The grove's telling.

sections.name: The avenue shops
sections.about: Two shopfronts on the avenue, #20 (general store, door B) and #19 (flower shop, door C), sharing one floor through a wide arch: provisions and tools on oak boards, cut flowers and pot plants on cobalt tile with a window onto the grove.

npcs.name: Hanne Ashby
npcs.greeting: Wraps, antidote, vials, cloth, needles and planks. Everything the plaza forgot, at the plaza's prices.

npcs.name: Bryony Larch
npcs.greeting: Sage for the temple, lavender for your pack, and nothing from the high branches. The grove and I have an understanding.

sections.name: The True Note
sections.about: The magic shop in #24 on the avenue (door D): a cobalt-tiled shop floor and a workshop behind it for the arcanist's lenses and reagents, a star chart on the back wall.

npcs.name: Ilka Tarn
npcs.greeting: The True Note. Higher reagents and focuses, every one of them tested by ear. If it does not ring, it is not on the shelf.

interactives.text: A star chart in gilt on deep blue. Small notes in the margin mark which stars ring truest through a tuning glass.

sections.name: The forge
sections.about: The smithy in #12 on the main row (door E, SW facade: the south wall): a packed-earth forge floor inside soot-brick walls, the smith's home kitchen and bedroom behind it.

npcs.name: Hild Ashlar
npcs.greeting: Arms and armour at the quartermaster's prices, and not a copper under. The forge is hot if you would rather make your own.

npcs.name: Pim
npcs.greeting: Mind the bellows. If you want Hild, she is the one hitting things. If you want somebody to talk to, I am the one not hitting things.

interactives.text: The forge is hot. Open your manufacture window to smith.

sections.name: Hemmen's house
sections.danger: A private home, open by day
sections.about: Hemmen's house in #22 on the avenue (door G): the study at the front where Aldith copies the register fair, the kitchen and living room beside it with the hearth, the bedroom behind.

npcs.name: Aldith
npcs.greeting: Mind the desk; the ink is wet. Hemmen writes the register. I write it again, so that there are two.

interactives.text: Aldith's copy desk: a fair copy of this spring's register lines, each one initialled twice, once by her and once by Hemmen.

sections.name: The weaver's house
sections.danger: A private home, open by day
sections.about: The weaver's house in #27 on the avenue's south side (door H, facing north: the north wall): the loom workroom at the front where Wynn weaves the cloth for her daughter Mara's capes, the kitchen and bedroom behind.

npcs.name: Wynn Vell
npcs.greeting: Mind the warp; it is longer than the room. Mara sells the capes. I make them, and I make them slowly.

interactives.text: Wynn's loom, strung with cape cloth in cobalt and cream. Mara sells what comes off it on the plaza; the hem stitch is her mother's.

sections.name: The watch house
sections.about: The watch house in #11 by the west gate (door I, facing west: the west wall): the mess at the front with its hearth and the duty board, the bunk room behind; a billet shared by the peoples who keep Landfall's watch.

npcs.name: Batu Ensh
npcs.greeting: The watch house. If you are lost, sit. If you are in trouble, sit faster.

npcs.name: Oma-Nuri
npcs.greeting: Night watch. I am awake because somebody has to be, and polite because the sergeant is listening.

interactives.text: The watch duty board: a column for each people that keeps the watch, names chalked in eight hands, and nobody's name at the top.

sections.name: The net-mender's house
sections.danger: A private home, open by day
sections.about: The net-mender's house in #56 on the south court (door J, facing west: the west wall): a hearth kitchen at the front, the net loft behind it with the nets, pots and rope from every boat on the isle, and Jessamy's bed in its corner.

npcs.name: Jessamy Reel
npcs.greeting: Step over the floats. If you are here about a net, put it on the frame. If you are here about the beacon, sit down; I tell it badly and it takes a while.

interactives.text: Jessamy's net frame: a boat's net stretched over the mending table, half its knots new. She says she can tell which harbour tied the old ones.

sections.name: The keep
sections.about: The palace keep #1 (door K, facing west: the west wall): the Gate Hall, the Hall of Eight Seats where the delegations sit in a closed ring under each people's banner, the Register Archive where the Luminous shelve the register's old volumes (the palace never answered their letter), the Palace Chancery, and behind it an alcove where a stair climbs to a shut door with a letter slot (no way through: the upper palace stays sealed).

npcs.name: Oswin
npcs.greeting: Wipe your feet. The delegations pay me to keep this floor clean and the doors open, and I do both.

npcs.name: Factor Rufus Dane
npcs.greeting: Rufus Dane, factor for the Westhaven houses. If you are here for the petition, you are early. If you are against it, you are Ssarathi.

npcs.name: Asi-Nem
npcs.greeting: Sit, if you like; the petitioner's place is in the middle and it is not comfortable. Ask me about the river, not the vote. The vote does not change.

npcs.name: Envoy Tolui Odhan
npcs.greeting: I am the Orun envoy. Forgive me if I do not sit. Everything in this keep belongs to a host I have never met.

npcs.name: Kesra Halde
npcs.greeting: Kesra Halde, for the Barrens. Speak from the middle of the ring, please. The room is honest there.

npcs.name: Liesl Penrose
npcs.greeting: The Register Archive: every volume of the Landing Register but the one Hemmen is writing in. Gloves, please.

npcs.name: Corbin Lask
npcs.greeting: League post, Landfall office. If it is for the palace, it goes up the stair. If you want an answer, it goes somewhere else.

interactives.text: A notice under the palace's seal, the first to come down in living memory: a south gate and a north one, cut this year beside the two old west gates. It calls this a renovation.
The map table of Landfall: the isle painted under glass, every post of the eight peoples marked in its own colour. Nobody has marked the keep.
The Luminous seat. Hemmen will not sit in it: a clerk who votes is a record that decides.
The Votary seat. Ostrid will not leave her door, and no other Votary will sit in her place.
The Mycelari seat. Lichen has grown over its arms; the Mycelari asked that nobody scrape it off, and nobody has.
The Stoneborn seat. They cut the stone it stands on and sent no chair and no delegate: a cut stone, they say, keeps a place well enough.
The register volume of the great freeze, open at six names in one shaking hand. Two of the six lines have never been closed.
A letter slot in the shut door at the top of the stair. Whatever goes through is gone by morning; in two hundred years, two things have come back down.

sections.name: The Unlit Boat, upstairs
sections.about: The tavern's upper floor, reached by the stairs from the stair hall: a landing along the back, three guest rooms and the Orl family's room at the front.

npcs.name: Edwy Coyle
npcs.greeting: Room three. I am leaving on the next boat. I have been leaving on the next boat for eleven days.

interactives.text: Bettany's recipe book, spine split. The first page is in her mother's hand: delta eel, slow over smoke. Under it, in Bettany's: never rush it.
